rows.description: Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet (Bufdir) publishes the Barnefattigdom kommunemonitor on bufdir.no and ships a single bulk ZIP of `Indikator_*.xlsx` workbooks ("last ned hele datasettet"). Atlas downloads that ZIP (URL discovered from the monitor page), parses sheet `Data` in each workbook, and loads kommune- and sub-kommune-level time series into `raw.bufdir_barnefattigdom` so analysts can compare Bufdir's poverty lens with register-based sources such as SSB low-income statistics.
rows.attribution: Kilde: Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet, Barnefattigdom kommunemonitor

rows.description: FHI Folkehelsestatistikk table 332 — share of Ungdata respondents reporting alcohol use one or more times in the past year. Risk-direction youth-substance-use indicator on the Ungdata cohort base.

FHI Folkehelsestatistikk table 338 — Befolkningssammensetning. Population counts by region × sex × age band, used as the demographic denominator across other indicators (per-capita rates, age structure).

FHI Folkehelsestatistikk table 185 — year-over-year population growth per region (counts and percent rates). Pairs with fhi-befolkning (observed) and fhi-prognose (projected) for full historical-and-forecast trajectories.
FHI Folkehelsestatistikk table 187 — "Personer som bor alene". Share of adults (16+) living alone, per region, annual.
